title: 🚀 OptionMAV Android is live - one of the most powerful options apps out there
author: Medicine_Blogscanner

replies.author: Medicine_Blogscanner
replies.body:
Hi great question.

The signal inference and the AI scoring runs on your phone. Not a server or "the cloud." Your signals never leave your device to get scored. Most options apps out there are phoning home to a server farm- OptionMAV thinks for itself, live, in your pocket.

What you get with the app:

* Full options Greeks - delta, gamma, theta, vega, rho and beyond calculated live, on-device
* An automated exit engine watching your positions around the clock, telling you when to get out before you even ask
* Covered calls, credit spreads, roll alerts included
* Uses our hosted model on the server or your own trained model (via the USB product- more information on our websites [trademav.com](http://trademav.com) and [optionmav.com](http://optionmav.com) )

Quick way to explain what OptionMAV's models actually do, they are like American Idol judges ( please refer to our [reddit post](https://www.reddit.com/r/trademav/comments/1uoaj7z/our_ai_models_on_the_app_are_basically_the/) )

And you choose who trains the judge - pair your OptionMAV USB and it learns from your own data, or run our server-trained model if you're starting fresh.
